full_prompt_en: A square, finely textured figurative painting shows a young woman in close left-facing profile amid a tightly packed crowd of partly visible faces. Her pale head and long neck dominate the center, framed by a rounded russet-red covering over dark smooth hair. The lower part of her body is cropped, though a black neckline and deep red garment appear at the bottom. Her face is calm and slightly withdrawn, with a slim dark eyebrow, gray-green eye looking left, straight nose, and gently closed rose lips. The skin is modeled with delicate cream, peach, and warm gray transitions, without strong lines on the cheek. At the left edge, an older man's bearded face and brown hat enter in profile. Beneath him, two smaller female profiles stack diagonally, one with warm yellow hair and one with a darker cap. Behind the central woman's head, a blond face looks outward from the upper right, partly obscured by the rust-colored covering. Green-blue clothing and muted patterned forms fill the remaining background, with round warm floral shapes near the lower right. The overlapping faces make the space compressed and shallow, yet each contour remains distinct enough to follow. The painted surface has a uniform fine grain, with subtly stippled color and meticulous, almost enamel-smooth modeling over the main face. Light is soft and diffuse from the upper left, keeping pale skin luminous while the crowded surroundings settle into deeper olive, teal, and brown. The overall composition uses the central ivory profile and red rounded hair shape as a quiet anchor amid a dense tapestry of neighboring faces and ornamental color.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、肌理细密的具象绘画描绘一位年轻女子的近距离左向侧影，周围紧密挤着局部可见的人脸。她的浅色头部与修长脖颈占据中央，深色光滑头发上覆盖圆润赭红头巾。身体下部被裁切，底部仍可见黑色领口与深红衣服。面庞平静而略显疏离，细深眉、望向左方的灰绿眼、直鼻和轻闭的玫瑰色嘴唇清楚。皮肤由细腻的奶油、桃色和暖灰渐变塑形，脸颊没有强线。左边缘，一位年长男子戴棕帽、蓄须的侧脸进入。其下，两张较小女子侧脸斜向堆叠，一人有暖黄色头发，另一人戴更深的帽子。主角头后，右上方一张金发面孔向外望，部分被锈红头巾挡住。绿蓝衣物与低饱和纹样填满余下背景，右下附近有圆形暖色花纹。重叠人脸使空间压缩而浅，但各轮廓仍足够分明。绘画表面有均匀细颗粒，色彩轻微点染，主面庞以近似珐琅的细致平滑笔法塑造。柔光从左上方漫射而来，使浅色皮肤发亮，拥挤背景则沉入较深的橄榄、青绿和褐色。整体构图以中央象牙色侧影与红色圆润发形为安静支点，置于邻近人脸和装饰色彩编成的密集织锦中。
style_prompt_en: The image has a finely grained, carefully blended painted surface, with pale smooth focal planes amid a tapestry of smaller overlapping forms. Russet red, ivory, muted teal, olive, ochre, and brown recur in compact areas, making the palette warm but varied. Contours are clear and gently rounded; neighboring shapes press close together without strong linear separation. Subtle stippling and layered color give even the smooth regions a soft tactile quality. Diffuse light raises the principal pale area while darker cool-warm mixtures recede around it, creating depth within an otherwise shallow crowded arrangement. The overall effect is poised and decorative, with a large quiet shape organizing many smaller color rhythms.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细颗粒、仔细融合的绘画表面，浅色平滑焦点平面置于小型叠压形体织成的图案中。赭红、象牙白、低饱和青绿、橄榄、赭黄与褐色在紧凑区域反复出现，让色域温暖而多变。轮廓清楚、轻柔圆润，相邻形状紧紧相贴，却无强硬分隔线。细微点染与层叠颜色使平滑区域也带柔软触感。漫射光提亮主要浅色区，周围较深的冷暖混色后退，在原本浅而拥挤的布局内创造纵深。整体效果沉稳且装饰性强，以大块安静形状组织许多较小的色彩节拍。
theme_en: A young woman in a russet head covering amid closely packed faces
theme_zh: 年轻女子戴赭红头巾，身后人脸紧密交叠
name: Mark Gertler
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
